label: Glutamatergic Modulation as a Treatment for Depressive Symptoms Among Patients With Post-acute Sequelae of COVID (PASC): A Pilot Trial
summary: Status: ACTIVE NOT RECRUITING. Phase: PHASE2. Conditions: Long COVID / PASC; Post-acute Sequelae of COVID-19; Depressive Symptoms; Cognitive Dysfunction. Enrollment listed: 12. Registration metadata only; not an efficacy assessment.
